regulations.title: RACJ permit required to produce or sell alcohol
regulations.summary: Any business that produces, distributes, or serves alcoholic beverages in Quebec needs a permit from the Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux (RACJ), with different permit categories for producers, grocery stores, bars, and distributors.
regulations.regulation_name: Act respecting liquor permits (Loi sur les permis d'alcool)
regulations.authority: Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux (RACJ)
regulations.action_required: Identify the correct RACJ permit category for your alcohol activity and submit an application before producing or selling in Quebec.
regulations.penalty_note: Producing or selling alcohol without the correct RACJ permit is a legal offence subject to fines and seizure.
regulations.source_name: Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux (RACJ)

regulations.title: SAQ exclusive distribution rights for most alcoholic beverages
regulations.summary: The Société des alcools du Québec (SAQ) holds exclusive primary distribution rights for most alcoholic beverages in Quebec. Exceptions exist mainly for beer, light cider bottled in Quebec, and imports brought in through a licensed distributor's permit.
regulations.regulation_name: Act respecting the Société des alcools du Québec
regulations.action_required: Confirm whether your product category falls under an SAQ distribution exception; if not, arrange distribution through the SAQ.
regulations.penalty_note: Bypassing SAQ's exclusive distribution channel where required can void sales and trigger regulatory action.
regulations.source_name: Régie des alcools, des courses et des jeux (RACJ)

regulations.title: French-dominant labelling applies to alcohol packaging too
regulations.summary: Alcohol labels are also subject to the Charter of the French Language: French must be at least as prominent as any other language for product names, descriptions, and mandatory warnings.
regulations.regulation_name: Charter of the French Language, s. 51
regulations.authority: Office québécois de la langue française (OQLF)
regulations.action_required: Ensure alcohol labels meet the same French-prominence standard as packaged food labels before distribution.
regulations.penalty_note: Same OQLF enforcement track as other labelling violations: demand letters escalating to fines.
regulations.source_name: Office québécois de la langue française

regulations.title: Specific taxes on alcoholic beverages
regulations.summary: Alcoholic beverages sold in Quebec are subject to specific provincial taxes on top of QST, collected through the SAQ or the applicable RACJ permit holder depending on distribution channel.
regulations.regulation_name: Act respecting the Québec sales tax - specific tax on alcoholic beverages
regulations.action_required: Register with Revenu Québec and confirm the specific alcohol tax obligations for your distribution channel.
regulations.penalty_note: Unpaid specific taxes on alcohol can be retroactively assessed with penalties and interest.
